evidence.title: GitHub - jiji-hoon96/kalyx: A headless React DatePicker library with a composable API for date, range, time, and date-time. Zero CSS, under 16 KB, SSR-safe, and ISO-first. · GitHub

name: Kalyx
summary: Headless React date pickers (date, range, time, month, year, week) using ISO 8601 UTC strings.
description: Seven composable React pickers plus hooks under one headless composition API. Values go in and come out as ISO 8601 UTC strings, with no Date objects, and an opt-in display timezone keeps storage independent of the viewer's zone. Zero CSS, SSR-safe, WAI-ARIA accessible and i18n/RTL ready; shipped as @kalyx/react with @kalyx/core and date-fns, dayjs and luxon adapters.
contains: 7 pickers: date, range, time, date+time, month, year, week
ISO 8601 UTC string values; opt-in displayTimezone, no Date objects
~19 KB gzip for one picker, ~26 KB for all seven
SSR-safe with renderToString tests; WAI-ARIA roles and keyboard support
